head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: All 52 manifest files read in full (48 reviewed + 4 partners). Targeted go test of the bootstrap/statuscache/repos/profile tests passed at the head. Spec-named server tests checked: spec-5 (TestReposCasualProjects/AddCasualForcesAdditionalDir/AddDeveloperUnchanged/AddWithLabel/AddInitsGit/WelcomeBootstrapConcurrent/NavCasual), spec-8, spec-9, spec-11, spec-12, spec-14 server rows all present; gaps already in the known ledger (MIN-2 run history, MIN-3 existing .git, MIN-7 catalog completeness, MIN-18 legacy non-developer, NIT-8-r2 cross-instance delete, MIN-17 bootstrap status, MIN-5-r2 audience-change sync, MIN-11 routineSession, MIN-12 statusCache.Delete, MIN-15/NIT-16 profile test) were not re-reported. Cross-chunk: none suspected.

findings.claim: TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent (spec-5 Tests row: second POST while running -> conflict) passes without the concurrency guard: its server has no TokenDir, so handleWelcomeBootstrap's later 'bootstrap needs the routine token' guard (bootstrap.go:61-63) also answers 409, and the test asserts only the status code. Deleting the `if s.bootstrap.running` block (bootstrap.go:47-50) keeps the suite green.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go:44-69 and welcome_test.go:234-241. newTestServer(&Options{}) leaves tokenDir ""; verifyTokenPath -> routines.LegacyTokenPath("") = filepath.Join(".", "token") = internal/server/token (absent, ls of the package dir confirms) and ListTokenLabels("") -> os.ReadDir("") ErrNotExist -> nil, so tokenPath is "" and styleTestTarget().TokenPath is "" (routines.Scan("") fails first, returning the unlabeled target). With running=false and an empty form, bootstrapEnv returns no error and the token guard calls respond.WithConflict -> 409, identical to the running guard's status. The test never inspects the body, so it cannot tell the two 409s apart.
findings.fix: Give the test a token store (TokenDir with one labeled token file, as TestServer_CheckToken's tokenStore builds) so only the running guard can produce the 409, and assert the body contains "already in progress".

findings.claim: The fingerprint-error guard in the status cache decision (`fingerprintErr == nil` in data.Cached) has no test: every TestWorktreeStatusFragment* fixture is a git repo whose Fingerprint succeeds, so removing the guard keeps the suite green — while in production a repo whose Fingerprint fails on two consecutive loads stores and then matches fingerprint "" and serves the stale scan instead of re-scanning, the opposite of the documented 'a fingerprint error counts as changed' contract.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos.go:347-368 (Store is called with the failed fingerprint value, "" on error) and repos_test.go:409-463: TestWorktreeStatusFragmentServesCache uses reposTestEnv's git-initialised repo; no case points the registry at a non-git directory or otherwise makes repos.Fingerprint fail. Spec-14 TestFingerprint pins 'non-git dir -> error' at the registry layer only.
findings.fix: Add a TestWorktreeStatusFragmentServesCache case with a registry entry pointing at a non-git t.TempDir() and the counting stub: two plain loads must run the status script twice and never render ' · cached'.

findings.claim: The new permissions kind's default deep-link dimension (kindDimension["permissions"] = "harness-friction") is never asserted: the only permissions test (TestProposalVote/permissions-kind-accepted) checks the vote line, and its fixture carries no evidence sessions, so changing or dropping the dimension value keeps the suite green while permissions evidence links would open the batch page unfiltered.
findings.evidence: Re-read proposals.go:37-42 and sessionLinks (733-752): the map value is only consumed as the link dimension; handleProposalVote uses only key presence. proposals_test.go:598-622 fixture has no evidence; the renders-loaded-files case asserts the routine-candidate default for routines only.
findings.fix: Extend permissions-kind-accepted (or add a /proposals render case) with one evidence session resolvable via a batch fixture and assert the link carries dimension=harness-friction.
